column1: # Key of Charles V to Ferrante Gonzaga, 11 August 1542 (Biblioteca Estense), found by Prabal Gupta (issue #318, repository prabal-rje/branicki-1757, CC BY 4.0).
# A base sign is a consonant; a small digit above it adds the vowel: 1-5 and 6-0 both run a, e, i, o, u. The label names the shape of the sign in transcription.txt, not a value.

# Signs with no digit are single letters. The sign s marks a doubled or palatal consonant (de-s-e = desse; se-s-aladamente = señaladamente; Perpi-s-an = Perpiñan). A few rare signs are fixed by sense and are in decryption.txt only.
